tests.description: Element-wise integer addition of two 1024-element arrays
tests.expected_behavior: c[i] = a[i] + b[i] for every i

tests.description: Element-wise integer multiplication with mixed-sign operands
tests.expected_behavior: c[i] = a[i] * b[i] for every i; no overflow by construction

tests.description: Integer division and remainder with negative operands
tests.expected_behavior: C++ semantics: quotient truncates toward zero, remainder has the sign of the dividend

tests.description: Single-precision multiply, divide, add and subtract
tests.expected_behavior: out[i] = x*y + x/y - 0.5*y, equal to the double-precision reference within float32 rounding error

tests.description: SAXPY: y = 2.5 * x + y on 4096 floats
tests.expected_behavior: y[i] = 2.5 * x[i] + y[i]; inputs are chosen so results are exactly representable

tests.description: Data-dependent while loop and if/else (Collatz step counts for 1..1000)
tests.expected_behavior: steps[i] = number of Collatz steps from i+1 down to 1

tests.description: Partial last block (n = 1000, 256 threads per block) with a guard region after the array
tests.expected_behavior: out[i] = 2*i + 1 for i < 1000; all 32 guard elements still hold -1

tests.description: Grid-stride kernel with a single element
tests.expected_behavior: c[0] = 3*a[0] - b[0]; the other 4095 threads do nothing

tests.description: Grid-stride kernel with 257 elements (one past a power of two)
Grid-stride kernel with 65537 elements (more elements than threads)
tests.expected_behavior: c[i] = 3*a[i] - b[i]; each thread processes up to 17 elements

tests.description: Shared-memory tree reduction + atomicAdd over 1,000,003 integers
tests.expected_behavior: Exact integer sum of (i % 10); n is not a multiple of the block size

tests.description: Shared-memory tree reduction + atomicAdd over 2^20 floats
tests.expected_behavior: Sum of 1/(1 + i % 1000) within 2e-5 relative; summation order on the GPU is not fixed
